A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ERK-Guid research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Textual and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic experiments, ImageNet and FFHQ evaluations, and qualitative text-to-image results, with additional experiments in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains those original synthetic, ImageNet, FFHQ and text-to-image results, including the appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The stiffness and eigenvector estimators, gated guidance update, solver adaptations and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The ERK-Proj extension in Appendix B.4 is also retained unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic 2D task, ImageNet at 512×512 and 64×64, FFHQ at 64×64, and PixArt-α text-to-image examples. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same unguided, CFG, Autoguidance, Heun, DPM-Solver and DEIS methods. The adaptive-step and stochastic/deterministic predictor–corrector comparisons in Appendix B are unchanged.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, sampling-step and NFE budgets, guidance thresholds, and the 50,000-sample quantitative evaluation setting remain unchanged, including the protocols documented in Appendix B.

E4.justification: Estimator validation, hyperparameter sensitivity, scaling-function ablation, JVP convergence analysis and qualitative examples are unchanged. Figures 2–4 and 6–9 contain the same analyses.

E5.justification: Run/seed disclosures and uncertainty reporting are identical. Figure 7 retains the median and 25th/75th percentiles across seeds and timesteps.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative samples are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 2 retains 8-step FID values of 7.06 without guidance and 4.91 with ERK-Guid.

T1.justification: Equations 1, 15 and 16 receive punctuation only; their mathematical expressions are unchanged. The assumptions, Proposition 1 and Appendix A proofs and derivations are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about cost-free estimators, stiffness-aware solver-error guidance, compatibility with existing guidance and solvers, and improved sampling quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations of eigenvector alignment, complementary model and solver errors, and scaling-function tradeoffs remain unchanged. The estimator's reliability restriction to sufficiently stiff regions is also unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same hyperparameters, 300-iteration JVP reference procedure, hardware and computational-cost information. Pseudocode and the stated implementation access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and bibliography are identical. No cited work is added or removed, and positioning relative to model-based guidance and numerical solvers is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 removes the duplicated word 'Solver' from the Section 5.3 heading, adds commas in Equations 1, 15 and 16, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Remaining wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9, Tables 1–11 and Algorithm 1 retain their design, captions and placement. The punctuation and heading edits introduce no figure, table or page-layout reorganization.

improvement.justification: v2 provides only small editorial corrections to equation punctuation and the Section 5.3 heading, alongside the updated version stamp. These offer negligible polish while leaving the scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information and substantive explanations unchanged.
